capabilities: wrap English segments in inline code
skip existing backticks, links, and tags
format the current selection or line
show an editor header toolbar button
extras: The README warns that this plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; much of the README covers the author's release workflow rather than plugin usage.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to fix spacing and inline-code styling in mixed Chinese/Japanese and English text.
summary: CJK–English typography formatter that inserts spaces at CJK–Latin boundaries and wraps English segments in inline code.
